Pursuant to Regulation 31A(6)(c) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Late Kumud Dinesh Mody, a member of the Promoter Group, held 25 equity shares in the Company. Of these, 13 shares have been transmitted to Mr. Pranabh Dinesh Mody (Promoter) and the remaining 12 shares to Ms. Purvi Uday Asher (member of Promoter group). Accordingly, the name of Late Kumud Dinesh Mody is not shown in the Individual - Promoter Group category.
Namplas Chemicals Pvt Ltd, J B Mody Enterprises LLP, Namrata Kushal Dalal, Shirish Bhagwanlal Mody and Bharati Shirish Mody are holding NIL shares and in given XBRL the same are not getting added in the total number of members of Promoter and Promoter group and total number in XBRL is appearing as 30 instead of 35 Promoter group members.
As on June 30, 2026, 1,44,421 Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)/Employee Stock Options granted by the Company to its employees under its stock incentive plan(s) were outstanding and pending exercise. As required by the format, these have been disclosed under 'No. of Shares Underlying Outstanding ESOPs' and included in computing the total number of shares on a fully diluted basis. Accordingly, the total number of shares on a fully diluted basis (1,53,30,892) exceeds the present paid-up equity share capital of the Company (1,51,86,471 shares), and the shareholding percentages on a fully diluted basis differ correspondingly. The outstanding RSUs/options carry no voting or dividend rights, and the paid-up capital and shareholding percentages will undergo change only upon exercise and consequent allotment of equity shares.
